sections.title: Introduction
sections.text: This report covers the Q3 2026 camera module testing results for the MCN5 image sensor. Testing was carried out at the Suwon optics lab between July 7 and September 12, 2026.
sections.summary: Introduces the Q3 2026 test campaign for the MCN5 image sensor, including test dates and location.

sections.title: Background
sections.text: The MCN5 sensor is a 50 MP, 1/1.56-inch stacked CMOS sensor intended for mid-range smartphones. It was tested under various lighting conditions ranging from 10 lux (dim indoor) to 1,000 lux (overcast daylight). Signal-to-noise ratio improves steadily with illuminance and plateaus above 500 lux.
sections.summary: Describes the MCN5 50 MP stacked CMOS sensor and the 10-1,000 lux lighting range used, with an SNR-vs-illuminance figure.

sections.title: Test Methodology
sections.text: Each module was mounted on a calibrated optical bench and evaluated against ISO 12233 and ISO 15739 charts. Twenty production-sample modules were tested; values below are medians.
sections.summary: Explains the optical bench setup, ISO 12233/15739 charts, and the 20-module sample size.

sections.title: Image Quality Metrics
sections.text: Test Result Target Notes MTF50 (center) 0.42 cycles/pixel >= 0.38 Pass MTF50 (corner) 0.31 cycles/pixel >= 0.28 Pass SNR @ 1000 lux 38.1 dB >= 36 dB Pass Distortion 1.2% <= 1.0% Fail Color accuracy (dE2000) 3.4 <= 4.0 Pass The MTF curve shows a corner fall-off consistent with the lens design, remaining above target.
sections.summary: Summarizes measured metrics; all pass except distortion at 1.2%. Includes an MTF curve figure.

sections.title: Conclusion
sections.text: All tests passed except distortion, which exceeded the 1.0% limit by 0.2 percentage points. We recommend recalibrating the lens distortion correction profile in the ISP before the EVT2 build.
sections.summary: Concludes that only distortion failed and recommends recalibrating the ISP distortion profile before EVT2.

sections.title: Camera Team Weekly Sync - September 22, 2026
sections.text: Attendees: J. Kim (lead), A. Patel, M. Chen, S. Lee, R. Gomez Location: Conference Room 4B / video call
sections.summary: Weekly camera team meeting notes with attendees and location.

sections.title: Agenda
sections.text: 1. MCN5 test results review 2. EVT2 build schedule 3. Supplier update for lens assemblies
sections.summary: Lists three agenda items: MCN5 test review, EVT2 schedule, and lens supplier update.

sections.title: MCN5 Test Results
sections.text: A. Patel presented the Q3 test report. All metrics passed except distortion (1.2% vs. 1.0% target). The team agreed the issue is correctable in the ISP and does not require a lens redesign.
sections.summary: Team reviewed Q3 results and agreed the distortion failure can be fixed in the ISP without lens redesign.

sections.title: EVT2 Build Schedule
sections.text: The EVT2 build remains scheduled for October 20, 2026. M. Chen noted that the recalibrated distortion profile must be delivered by October 10 to be included in the build firmware.
sections.summary: EVT2 stays on October 20; the distortion profile is due October 10 for firmware inclusion.

sections.title: Supplier Update
sections.text: S. Lee reported that the lens supplier has resolved the coating defect seen in August. Yield on the latest lot is 97.4%, up from 91.8%.
sections.summary: Lens supplier fixed the August coating defect; yield improved from 91.8% to 97.4%.

sections.title: Decisions
sections.text: Proceed with ISP-based distortion correction; no lens redesign. Keep the EVT2 date of October 20.
sections.summary: Decided on ISP-based distortion correction and keeping the EVT2 date.

sections.title: Action Items
sections.text: Owner Action Due A. Patel Deliver recalibrated distortion profile 2026-10-10 M. Chen Integrate profile into EVT2 firmware 2026-10-15 S. Lee Confirm supplier yield on next two lots 2026-10-06 R. Gomez Update project budget for EVT2 2026-09-30
sections.summary: Four action items with owners and due dates between Sept 30 and Oct 15.
